title: Observability: generic fips_gate messages omit return code
description: 14 fips_gate failure log sites (write, read, set_iv, gen_iv, set_aad, get_tag, set_tag, finalize, reset, sign, verify, agree, key_info, key_get_info) emit 'FIPS not operational' without the numeric return code. KEY_IMPORT/DO_KDF/KEY_GENERATE/KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE were fixed in pass-1 but the generic pattern across all session ioctls was not. When fips_gate() returns a non-standard code (e.g. from a POST failure vs. degraded state), a support engineer cannot distinguish which failure mode triggered from dmesg alone.
